method: No published source gives Fairfield shuttle boarding points: fairfield.edu lists stop names only, OpenStreetMap has no Fairfield University shuttle stops, the Concept3D campus map and TripShot tracker were not used (no public data access), and the 2023 parking-map brochure link returns 404. Every point below is a suggestion derived from mapped features matching the stop name. None is confirmed: an administrator approves each one, ideally after checking it on site.

confidence.high: A mapped road feature matches the stop name and is the only candidate.
confidence.medium: The named place is certain; the exact curb or boarding side is inferred.
confidence.low: The place itself is ambiguous; check before approving.

unresolved.block-17-walkway: Townhouse block numbers are not on any map found.
unresolved.block-13-walkway: Townhouse block numbers are not on any map found.

barone-traffic-circle.basis: South side of the Loyola Drive one-way loop (OSM way 971774262), the only traffic circle beside the Barone Campus Center; 73 m from the building.

walsh-lot-crosswalk.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM node 8338460224) between the surface lot west of the Walsh Athletic Center and the building. "Walsh Lot" is not named on any map found.

dolan-campus-circle.basis: Porter Road one-way loop (OSM way 741971905) beside John C. Dolan Hall on the former Dolan campus; 64 m from the hall.

library-meditz-crosswalk.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM node 9441279331) between DiMenna-Nyselius Library and Meditz Hall.

quick-center-crosswalk.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM node 9441134510) east of the Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts; 58 m from the building.

dsb-lower-lot-crosswalk.basis: Crosswalk (OSM way 1563950080) on the west side of the Charles F. Dolan School of Business beside a parking lot. Which lot is the "lower lot" is not mapped.

chapel-crosswalk.basis: Crosswalk (OSM node 14238766178) south of the Egan Chapel of Saint Ignatius Loyola; 57 m from the chapel.

crosswalk-behind-canisius.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM way 1023818970) south-west of Canisius Hall. Which side counts as "behind" is not stated anywhere found.

jogues-health-center.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM node 6996981727) beside Jogues Hall. The Health Center is not mapped, so the boarding side is unknown.

campion-crosswalk.basis: Marked crosswalk (OSM node 8338460208) north of Campion Hall; 45 m from the building.

fairfield-train-station.basis: Middle of the Unquowa Road bridge over the tracks at Fairfield station (OSM way 42990405): the only road overpass at the station.

140-mill-plain-road.basis: Address point for 140 Mill Plain Road, Fairfield (OSM node 8861935472). The curb position is not mapped.

fairfield-green.basis: Fairfield University Bookstore, 1499 Post Road (OSM node 3726955875); the sign says "near Bookstore".

grasmere-post-rd.basis: Intersection of Grasmere Avenue and Post Road (OSM node 84033803). Which corner the shuttle uses is not published.

metro-train-alto.basis: Alto Fairfield Metro Garage, 1401 Kings Highway (OSM relation 19903189), at Fairfield Metro station (mapped as Fairfield-Black Rock).

whole-foods.basis: Whole Foods Market, 350 Grasmere Avenue (OSM way 131545365), the only Whole Foods in Fairfield on OSM. Entrance position not mapped.

stop-and-shop.basis: Stop & Shop, 1160 Kings Highway Cutoff (OSM way 205826245). Fairfield has a second Stop & Shop (760 Villa Avenue); this one was chosen because it lies between Whole Foods and Marshalls/CVS on the printed route.

marshalls-cvs.basis: Between Marshalls (700 Post Road, OSM node 3703771292) and CVS Pharmacy (698 Post Road, OSM node 3703771288), which share a plaza.

bridgeport-train-station.basis: Bridgeport station (OSM node 7103163865). The shuttle's boarding side (Water Street or the bus terminal) is not published.

bellarmine-campus.basis: 460 Mill Hill Avenue, Bridgeport: the address fairfield.edu gives for Fairfield Bellarmine (OSM address node 8850608618). The drop-off spot is not mapped.
bellarmine-campus.source: OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), queried 2026-11-08; address from fairfield.edu/bellarmine/admission

1720-post-road.basis: Building at 1720 Post Road, Fairfield (OSM way 209690314). The entrance position is not mapped.
